findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed the ice machine is still soiled with some mold on interior baffles after cleaning. PIC was informed and deeper cleaning was conducted during today’s visit. The violation is now considered resolved with no further action needed.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed no paper towel present at the back hand sink. The PIC was informed and paper towels were supplied. Ensure disposable towels are available at all times to promote proper handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
Inspectors observed the following food-contact surfaces to be soiled and in need of cleaning:
1. REPEAT VIOLATION ice machine is soiled with mold on interior baffles
2. Interior of pizza ovens
3. Pizza cutters kept on exterior of ovens
4. Interior and exterior of popcorn machine

Ensure these food-contact surfaces are cleaned as frequently as necessary to prevent an accumulation of soil. A follow-up will be conducted on 12/29/2025 to ensure these items are clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed the seasoning shaker for the popcorn to be stored open under employee coats and personal items. The popcorn kernel bin under the machine in the cabinet was also observed left open. Ensure these containers are kept away from sources of contamination and sealed tightly when not in use.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Inspectors observed the door to the popcorn machine to be damaged and repaired with duct tape. The PIC was informed that duct tape is not a smooth, easily cleanable surface and therefore cannot be used on food-contact surfaces. Ensure the door to the machine is repaired with an approved material.

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed a small freshwater leak in a copper pipe near the back triple sink. This pipe previously supplied water to a dish machine. This machine has since been removed and the pipe is no longer needed. The PIC has plans to cap off and remove the unnecessary plumbing. Ensure these repairs are completed prior to the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Inspectors observed the coving around the bar to be peeling from the wall. Ensure the coving is sealed or replaced to prevent moisture accumulation in the wall. 

Inspectors also noted mold accumulating on the wall and floor below the freshwater leak mentioned in violation #51. Ensure the flooring and wall is cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
Observed several priority foundation violations during inspection. Correct priority foundation violations. 

2-102.11: Based on the RISKS inherent to the FOOD operation, PIC shall demonstrate knowledge by:  (A) Having no Priority Foundation items; (B) Being a CFM; OR (C) Responding correctly questions as they relate to the specific FOOD operation. The areas of knowledge include C1 through C16.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
Observed facility to not be able to produce signed employee reporting agreements for all food employees working at facility. Provide a signed employee reporting agreement for all food employees at facility. 

2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed no signage at handsinks in back room or bar designating sinks as handwashing only sinks. Provided facility with signage during inspection. 

6-301.14: A sign or poster that notifies FOOD EMPLOYEES to wash their hands shall be provided at all HANDWASHING SINKS used by FOOD EMPLOYEES and shall be clearly visible to FOOD EMPLOYEES.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.comment:
Observed soiled crock pots in and around 3 compartment sink in back room. PIC stated that customers bring in crockpots of food to share with other patrons. Advised PIC that no food made in a private home may be served at the facility. PIC stated that facility would discontinue the practice. 

3-201.11: (A)-(B) FOOD shall be obtained from APPROVED source and not from private home. P (C) PACKAGED Food shall be properly labeled. (E) WHOLE-MUSCLE BEEF shall be from approved source and acceptable from AUTHROITY. Pf (D) FISH must be frozen if consumed undercooked. (F) Meat and Poultry shall be properly labeled. (G) Eggs shall be properly labeled. C

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed baffle and interior of ice machine to be soiled with mold and debris. Clean and sanitize interior of ice machine. 

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed the interior cavity of microwave to be heavily soiled with food debris. Clean and sanitize interior cavity of microwave. 

4-602.12: (A) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking and baking EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours. This section does not apply to hot oil cooking and filtering EQUIPMENT if it is cleaned as specified in Subparagraph 4-602.11(D)(6). (B) The cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours by using the manufacturer's recommended cleaning procedure.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Observed wooden pallet used for storage in walk-in cooler. Seal wooden pallet or discard. 

4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
Observed facility to be unable to produce food handler certification for all food employees at facility. Provide proof of food handler verification for all food employees at facility.

410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Observed a bottle of Ibuprofen and a bottle of Tums in the drawer holding spoons and tongs. The bottles were moved to the “miscellaneous” drawer.  Violation corrected. 4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. 
Store food contact items in a way that will protect them from potential contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the outside of the soda gun to be soiled with dried and sticky residue.  
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Clean and maintain clean.
